name: @pipeworx/mcp-dummyjson

tools.name: products
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake products from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns product name, price, brand, category, thumbnail, and rating.

tools.name: product
tools.description: Fetch a single fake product by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns name, description, price, discount, brand, category, stock, images, and rating.

tools.name: product_search
tools.description: Search fake DummyJSON products by keyword `q`. Returns matching products with name, price, brand, category, and rating. Supports limit and skip for pagination.

tools.name: products_categories
tools.description: Return the full list of product category names available in DummyJSON (e.g. smartphones, laptops, fragrances). Use before filtering products by category.

tools.name: users
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake users from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns name, email, age, address, company, and role fields.

tools.name: user
tools.description: Fetch a single fake user by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns full profile including name, email, phone, address, bank, company, and crypto wallet.

tools.name: posts
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake blog posts from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns title, body, tags, reactions, and userId.

tools.name: post
tools.description: Fetch a single fake blog post by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns title, body, tags, reaction counts, and the authoring userId.

tools.name: comments
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake comments from DummyJSON. Supports limit and skip. Returns comment body, postId, and user info (id, username).

tools.name: recipes
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake recipes from DummyJSON. Supports limit, skip, and field selection via `select`. Returns name, ingredients, instructions, prep time, and cuisine.

tools.name: recipe
tools.description: Fetch a single fake recipe by numeric `id` from DummyJSON. Returns name, ingredients, instructions, prep/cook time, servings, difficulty, and cuisine.

tools.name: quotes
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake inspirational quotes from DummyJSON. Supports limit and skip. Returns quote text and author name.

tools.name: todos
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of fake todo items from DummyJSON. Supports limit and skip. Returns todo text, completion status, and userId.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dummyjson forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dummyjson pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
